اضطلعن (form VIII)
# اِضْطَلَعْنَ (iḍṭalaʕna) /idˤ.tˤa.laʕ.na/: third-person feminine plural past active of اِضْطَلَعَ (iḍṭalaʕa)
# اِضْطَلِعْنَ (iḍṭaliʕna) /idˤ.tˤa.liʕ.na/: second-person feminine plural imperative of اِضْطَلَعَ (iḍṭalaʕa)
maddeler.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
